raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "howardhinnant_date" %}
{% set version = "3.0.5" %}
{% set sha256 = "ef786edc203daec76475825640b3af247bd08e31fc52217e5ce8f76107b4bb05" %}

{% set install_prefix = "." %}  # [unix]
{% set install_prefix = "Library" %}  # [win]
{% set shlib_ext = "so" %}  # [linux]
{% set shlib_ext = "dylib" %}  # [unix and not linux]

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  fn: {{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  url: https://github.com/HowardHinnant/date/archive/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: {{ sha256 }}
  patches:
    - patches/0001-Locate-zoneinfo-based-on-install-prefix.patch
    - patches/0002-static-library-zoneinfo-discovery.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip: true  # [win and vc<14]

outputs:
  - name: howardhinnant_date
    script: build_shared.sh  # [unix]
    script: build_shared.bat  # [win]
    build:
      run_exports:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('howardhinnant_date', max_pin='x.x') }}
    files:
      - include/date                                    # [unix]
      - lib/libdate-tz*.{{ shlib_ext }}*                # [unix]
      - lib/cmake/date                                  # [unix]
      - {{ install_prefix }}/include/date               # [win]
      - {{ install_prefix }}/bin/date-tz.dll            # [win]
      - {{ install_prefix }}/lib/date-tz.lib            # [win]
      - {{ install_prefix }}/cmake                      # [win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - make  # [unix]
        - pkg-config
        - gnuconfig
      host:
        - dirent  # [win]
      run:
        - tzdata
    test:
      requires:
        - cmake
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ninja
      files:
        - test
      commands:
        # headers and cmake config
        - test -d ${PREFIX}/include/date  # [unix]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/date/date.h  # [unix]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/date/dateConfig.cmake  # [unix]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\date\date.h exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\cmake\dateConfig.cmake exit 1  # [win]
        # shared library present, static archive absent
        - test -n "$(find ${PREFIX}/lib -maxdepth 1 -name 'libdate-tz.so*' -print -quit)"  # [linux]
        - test -n "$(find ${PREFIX}/lib -maxdepth 1 -name 'libdate-tz*.dylib' -print -quit)"  # [osx]
        - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libdate-tz.a  # [unix]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\date-tz.dll exit 1  # [win]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\date-tz.lib exit 1  # [win]
        - if exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\date-tz_static.lib exit 1  # [win]
        - cd test
        - cmake . -GNinja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
        - cmake --build . --config Release
        - ln -s ${PREFIX}/share/zoneinfo/UTC ${PREFIX}/share/zoneinfo/CondaTest  # [unix]
        - mklink %PREFIX%\share\zoneinfo\CondaTest %PREFIX%\share\zoneinfo\UTC  # [win]
        - ./program  # [unix]
        - program.exe  # [win]

  - name: howardhinnant_date-static
    script: build_static.sh  # [unix]
    build:
      skip: true  # [win]
      run_exports:
        - tzdata
    files:
      - include/date                                    # [unix]
      - lib/libdate-tz.a                                # [unix]
      - lib/cmake/date                                  # [unix]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - make  # [unix]
        - pkg-config
        - gnuconfig
      run:
        - tzdata
    test:
      requires:
        - cmake
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ninja
      files:
        - test
      commands:
        # static archive present, shared library absent
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libdate-tz.a  # [unix]
        - test -z "$(find ${PREFIX}/lib -maxdepth 1 -name 'libdate-tz.so*' -print -quit)"  # [unix]
        - test -z "$(find ${PREFIX}/lib -maxdepth 1 -name 'libdate-tz*.dylib' -print -quit)"  # [unix]
        # headers and cmake config
        - test -d ${PREFIX}/include/date  # [unix]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/date/date.h  # [unix]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/date/dateConfig.cmake  # [unix]
        - cd test
        - cmake . -GNinja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DUSE_STATIC_TZ=ON
        - cmake --build . --config Release
        - ln -s ${PREFIX}/share/zoneinfo/UTC ${PREFIX}/share/zoneinfo/CondaTest  # [unix]
        - ./program  # [unix]

about:
  home: http://github.com/HowardHinnant/date
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: A C++ date and time library
  description: A date and time library based on the C++11/14/17 <chrono> header
  doc_url: http://howardhinnant.github.io/date/date.html
  dev_url: http://github.com/HowardHinnant/date

extra:

    - JohanMabille
    - jjerphan
    - pidefrem
    - gabm
    - apmorton
